questions.question: Explain why 1 cm² = 100 mm² and 1 m² = 10 000 cm².
questions.expected_answer: 1 cm² is 10 mm by 10 mm, so 10 × 10 = 100 mm². 1 m² is 100 cm by 100 cm, so 100 × 100 = 10 000 cm². Area uses the length factor twice.
